decisions.reason: A rye country bread fits the core range and uses existing production, so keeping it open costs little while early demand is still uncertain.
The repeated gold medal from the German Bread Institute signals realized value for this flagship stollen, which justifies further commitment rather than abandonment.
A seeded rye mixed bread is a low-cost variant on established recipes, and with no negative signals yet the option is worth keeping.
Dark malt rye bread overlaps with several other rye products, but it costs little to maintain, so it stays until results show weak demand.
Marzipan stollen is a seasonal complement to the core stollen business with minimal holding cost, so the option remains open for the next Christmas season.
The ancient grain bread was just launched as the newest 'masterpiece' and its prospects are still uncertain, so it is too early to drop it.
